# Clocked contract fixtures

These files are test-only captures of the complete recorded JSON responses published in
Clocked's official Compare and Grounding documentation. They are not live Necra responses,
runtime fallbacks, accuracy guarantees, or customer data.

- `compare-recorded-response.json`: official Compare documentation, recorded 2026-10-21;
  accessed 2026-11-05.
- `grounding-recorded-response.json`: official Grounding documentation, recorded
  2026-10-08; accessed 2026-11-05.

Source pages:

- https://clocked.rezolve.ai/docs/compare
- https://clocked.rezolve.ai/docs/grounding
